rejection_summary.title: The Protector
rejection_summary.reason: The Tony Jaa film exists in substantially different 83-minute international/US and roughly 110-minute original versions. Heroic Cinema and other whole-film coverage document significant story subplots and slower passages in the longer cut, while action-heavy reviews often discuss the shortened cut. The version-dependent runtime makes a single confident whole-film action-density assessment unsuitable today; the impressive restaurant long take and finale alone are not enough.
